title: Business Landing Page
description: Sample conversion-focused landing page concept for presenting a business service, value proposition and clear call to action.
objective: Demonstrate front-end skills in creating a focused landing page with clear content hierarchy and responsive layout.
steps: Defined the main value proposition and page structure.
Organized the content into a clear introduction, service information and call to action.
Built the layout using HTML and CSS.
Added JavaScript where needed for interactive behavior.
Reviewed spacing, readability and responsiveness across screen sizes.
results: Created a sample business landing page structure designed to communicate a service clearly and guide visitors toward a defined action.
